topic: The symptoms had been getting worse
title: The symptoms had been getting worse
pt: Foco da aula: past perfect contínuo: evolução de sintomas

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

group90.name: Pausa
group90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Clara, you finally saw the doctor! How long had you been feeling ill before you went in?
lines.pt: Clara, você finalmente viu o médico! Há quanto tempo você vinha se sentindo mal antes de ir?

lines.en: For almost a month. My symptoms had been getting worse, but I had been telling myself it was just stress.
lines.pt: Quase um mês. Meus sintomas vinham piorando, mas eu vinha me dizendo que era só estresse.

lines.en: What had you been noticing exactly? The doctor must have asked you about the early signs.
lines.pt: O que você vinha notando exatamente? O médico deve ter perguntado sobre os primeiros sinais.

lines.en: I had been coughing every night, and I had been waking up with a sore throat and a slight fever.
lines.pt: Eu vinha tossindo toda noite e vinha acordando com dor de garganta e uma febre leve.

lines.en: And had you been taking anything for it, or had you been waiting for it to pass?
lines.pt: E você vinha tomando alguma coisa para isso, ou vinha esperando que passasse?

lines.en: I had been drinking hot lemon tea, but it hadn’t been helping. The cough had been keeping me awake.
lines.pt: Eu vinha tomando chá quente de limão, mas não vinha ajudando. A tosse vinha me deixando acordada.

lines.en: No wonder you were exhausted when I saw you last week. You looked as if you had been running a marathon.
lines.pt: Não é à toa que você estava exausta quando te vi semana passada. Parecia que tinha corrido uma maratona.

lines.en: That’s how I felt! By Friday I had been struggling to breathe, so my neighbour drove me to the hospital.
lines.pt: Foi assim que me senti! Na sexta eu vinha tendo dificuldade para respirar, então minha vizinha me levou ao hospital.

lines.en: Thank goodness she did. What did the doctor say after he had examined you for a while?
lines.pt: Graças a Deus. O que o médico disse depois que te examinou por um tempo?

lines.en: He said I had been developing a chest infection, and that I would have to rest for at least ten days.
lines.pt: Ele disse que eu vinha desenvolvendo uma infecção no peito e que eu teria de descansar pelo menos dez dias.

lines.en: Well, you had been ignoring the warning signs for weeks, so now you must follow his advice carefully.
lines.pt: Bem, você vinha ignorando os sinais de alerta havia semanas, então agora precisa seguir o conselho dele com cuidado.

items.wrong: I was been coughing for a week.
items.fix: I had been coughing for a week.
items.why: Use had been + -ing for a continuous action before a past moment.

items.wrong: I have been ill before I went to hospital.
items.fix: I had been ill before I went to hospital.
items.why: Before a past event, use the past perfect (continuous), not the present perfect.

items.wrong: She had been tired since three weeks.
items.fix: She had been tired for three weeks.
items.why: Use for with a period of time.

facts.label: Past perfect contínuo
facts.sub: Ação em curso antes de um ponto no passado: My symptoms had been getting worse. Pergunta: How long had you been…?

facts.label: Vinha fazendo
facts.sub: Forme com had + been + verbo-ing: I had been coughing. Use para uma ação que durava até um momento do passado. Em português: “eu vinha tossindo”. É igual para todas as pessoas, de I a they.

facts.label: Explicar a causa
facts.sub: Use para explicar um resultado no passado: She was exhausted because she had been coughing all night. A ação mais antiga usa had been; o resultado usa o passado simples.

facts.label: Had you been…?
facts.sub: Para perguntar: How long had you been feeling ill? Had you been taking anything? Na resposta curta, use Yes, I had ou No, I hadn’t. Para duração, use for e since.

facts.label: Duração ou resultado
facts.sub: Had been + -ing destaca a duração: I had been waiting for an hour. O past perfect simples destaca o resultado: I had finished my medicine. Com always, know, want, use o simples.

items.s: Had been + -ing shows an action in progress before a past moment.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: We use it to explain the background of a past event.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: It is the same as the present perfect continuous.
items.why: It looks back from a point in the past, not from now.

items.target: I had been drinking hot lemon tea, but it hadn’t been helping. The cough had been keeping me awake.

items.cue: Foi assim que me senti! Na sexta eu vinha tendo dificuldade para respirar, então minha vizinha me levou ao hospital.
items.target: That’s how I felt! By Friday I had been struggling to breathe, so my neighbour drove me to the hospital.
